remarks: Walk to the beach! Rare opportunity to own 2 flat acres encompassing a renovated beach house and a remarkable modern barn designed with walls of glass. All uniquely located in the Greens Farm community of Westport, boasting LI Sound beach access and abutting the Connecticut Audubon trails. An updated 3-bedroom Cape offers one level living with a primary suite on the main floor and two bedrooms on the upper level. A glass enclosed sunroom with French doors opens to a private patio overlooking the expansive fenced yard. The beautifully renovated two story barn with skylights and oversized windows capture an abundance of the surrounding light from the rear Western exposure. Two half baths and an upper-level space for work or relaxation complete the barn. This seaside beach residence with glorious grounds features specimen trees, wildflowers and more. The main home offers 1882 square feet. The barn provides an additional 2,098 square feet. This seaside beach residence uses solar panels and has a generator. Vacation living can be embraced everyday!
